clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge, Magni Bronzebeard leads his people through grief and political strain. Lord of Ironforge, Thane of the Bronzebeard clan, and ruler of Khaz Modan, he is a veteran of the Second War who champions dwarven archaeology across Azeroth.

Magni Bronzebeard grew up as the eldest of three brothers, knowing the mountain's rule would one day fall to him. When the Horde invaded during the Second War, he held Ironforge behind its impenetrable gates. Once the siege broke, he pledged Khaz Modan to the Alliance of Lordaeron. In the peace that followed, Magni welcomed his gnomish allies after Gnomeregan fell, granting High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque and the refugees sanctuary beneath the mountain. Magni then sought to unite the fractured northern and southern kingdoms. He asked Mekkatorque to build the Deeprun Tram, an unprecedented route beneath the earth that connects Ironforge directly to Stormwind.

Magni carries a deep sorrow beneath his regal bearing. During the Third War, word came from Northrend that his beloved younger brother, Muradin, had perished on Prince Arthas Menethil's expedition. Grief overwhelmed Magni, but he and his youngest brother, Brann, remained steadfast in their duty to the dwarven people. Magni still rules wisely, with that loss weighing upon him.

Magni has turned dwarven society from traditional commercial mining toward the unearthing of ancient history. Strange titan relics found deep beneath the earth inspired him to co-found the Explorers' League with his surviving brother, Brann Bronzebeard. Dwarven dig sites now span the continents, from Dun Morogh to Kalimdor, as the League seeks the truth of the dwarves' fabled origins. Peace at home remains fragile. Magni's daughter, Princess Moira, has gone missing, believed kidnapped by the hated Dark Iron clan.
